fieldNotes.location: UNFI's 323,000 sq ft Auburn WA DC. Resolved to the Valley Centre industrial complex on B St NW, Auburn 98001 - LoopNet/CoStar tie the 'United Natural Foods - Valley Centre Bldg 3' name and APN 000460-0043 to 2530 B St NW (181,300 sq ft on 8.1 acres). UNFI occupied Bldg 3 plus expansion space; campus center locked at 47.32655,-122.24905.
fieldNotes.status: UNFI publicly announced (2019) closure of the Auburn DC, consolidating PNW volume into the new Centralia DC (idx 21) and expanded Ridgefield DC (idx 22); customer transition completed early 2020. Imagery still shows an intensely active reefer/dry-van DC operation with yard hostlers - whether UNFI or a successor tenant, the physical yard is a working large-scale grocery DC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence runs the full B St NW frontage; truck driveways are open gaps in the fence with no barrier arm or booth visible from 2025-04 Street View. Classed truckGate true on the controlled-checkpoint pinch-point of a fenced commercial yard, but flagged uncertain - no hard barrier confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any driveway along B St NW; remoteGs marked true on that basis (gate with no shack implies kiosk/call-box check-in).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Valley Centre is a multi-building campus - 4+ large warehouse buildings share the truck court and trailer rows.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer storage rows on the south and north sides of the truck court, full of reefers - clear dedicated drop-yard, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Counts are honest estimates from z19-z20 imagery over a multi-building campus; dock door count spans several building faces and is approximate.
